Meaning drift risk from merged markers: list boundaries are unclear for downstream parsing; needs separation to match original structure.
Scrambled/missing list structure in Article 2: original has no paragraph (1) but translation refers to paragraph (1); principles should be presented as a list matching the original sequence.

Scrambled list structure in Articles 3, 6, 7, and 8: original uses semicolon-separated items without markers; translation keeps them as run-on text. For downstream boundary-splitting, items should be explicitly listed and kept in order.

List marker formatting issues in Article 10/11/13: original has lettered items a–j / a–f; translation adds blank lines between items (not fatal) but must ensure markers appear once and in order; also original has merged 'danj.'/'andf.' which should be separated as 'and j.'/'and f.' Broken numbering/list structure in Article 18: original has an unnumbered first paragraph under Pasal 18 followed by items 2–4; translation keeps this but should explicitly preserve the missing item (1) marker to match the original structure used downstream.

# BAB VII

## PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN

#### Pasal 35

Bupati berkewajiban melakukan pembinaan dan Pengawasan Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak.  

Pembinaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi: menyelenggarakan bimbingan teknis dan pelatihan; dan menyediakan fasilitas untuk pemenuhan Standar Pelayanan.  

Pembinaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan untuk mewujudkan Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak sesuai Standar Pelayanan yang dilaksAnakan oleh P2TP2A dan Lembaga-Lembaga yang melaksAnakan layanan pemenuhan dan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak.

#### Pasal 36

Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada Pasal 35 ayat (1)  meliputi: melakukan pemantauan dan evaluasi terhadap Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak; dan menerima dan menindaklanjuti laporan.  

Pelaksanaan Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan secara transparan dan akuntabel.

# BAB VIII

## PELAPORAN

#### Pasal 37

1. SKPD yang menyelenggarakan tugas dan fungsi bidang Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak menyampaikan laporan kepada Bupati tentang Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak di Daerah.  
2. Laporan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) disampaikan sekurang-kurangnya 1 (satu) kali dalam setahun.

# BAB IX

## PEMBIAYAAN

#### Pasal 38

Pembiayaan pelaksanaan Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak dibebankan pada APBD dan sumber dana lain yang sah dan tidak mengikat.

# BAB X

## KETENTUAN PIDANA

## Bagian Kesatu

Sanksi Pidana

#### Pasal 39

Setiap orang atau Lembaga yang melanggar ketentuan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 15 ayat (2) diancam pidana kurungan paling lama 6 (enam) bulan dan/atau denda paling banyak Rp. 50.000.000,- ( lima puluh juta rupiah).  

Tindak pidana sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) adalah pelanggaran.  

Setiap orang atau badan hukum yang melanggar ketentuan Pasal 23 diancam pidana berdasarkan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.

## Bagian Kedua

Sanksi Administratif

#### Pasal 40

Bagi Pegawai Negeri Sipil yang melakukan suatu tindakan atau tidak melakukan suatu tindakan yang dapat menghalangi atau mempersulit salah satu pihak yang dilayani sehingga mengakibatkan kerugian bagi yang dilayani dalam hal pengurusan hak sipil terhadap pemenuhan hak Anak sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 11 huruf e dan huruf f, dikenakan hukuman disiplin sesuai peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan/atau sanksi administratif berupa pemberhentian sementara dari jabatan.  

Mekanisme pemberian sanksi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dan ayat (2) diatur lebih lanjut dengan Peraturan Bupati.

# BAB XI

## KETENTUAN PENUTUP

#### Pasal 41

Peraturan pelaksanaan dari Peraturan Daerah ini harus sudah ditetapkan paling lama 1 (satu) tahun terhitung sejak Peraturan Daerah ini diundangkan.

#### Pasal 42

Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku pada tanggal diundangkan.  

Agar setiap orang mengetahuinya, memerintahkan pengundangan Peraturan Daerah ini dengan menempatkannya dalam Lembaran Daerah Kabupaten Lombok Utara.  

Ditetapkan di Tanjung pada tanggal 30 Maret 2017

##### BUPATI LOMBOK UTARA,

##### H. NAJMUL AKHYAR

Diundangkan di Tanjung pada tanggal 30 Maret  2017

##### PENJELASAN

##### ATAS

##### PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN LOMBOK UTARA

##### NOMOR   TAHUN 2017

##### TENTANG

##### PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK

##### UMUM

Negara  memiliki  kewajiban  memberikan  Perlindungan  kepada  setiap  warga negara sesuai pembukaan UUD Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945. Bahwa Perempuan dan Anak termasuk kelompok rentan yang cenderung mengalami Kekerasan sehingga perlu mendapatkan  Perlindungan.  Kekerasan terhadap  Perempuan  dan  Anak merupakan pelanggaran hak asasi manusia sehingga perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya serta dijamin hak hidupnya tanpa adanya diskriminasi.  

Kekerasan  merupakan setiap  perbuatan  secara  melawan  hukum  dengan  atau  tanpa menggunakan  sarana  terhadap  fisik  dan  psikis  yang  menimbulkan  bahaya bagi nyawa,   badan   atau   menimbulkan   terampasnya kemerdekaan seseorang. Selanjutnya  Kekerasan  terhadap  Perempuan  merupakan  setiap  tindakan  berdasarkan perbedaan jenis kelamin  yang  berakibat  atau  mungkin  berakibat  kesengsaraan  atau penderitaan Perempuan secara fisik, seksual atau psikologis, termasuk ancaman tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan atau perampasan    kemerdekaan secara sewenang-wenang, baik yang terjadi di ranah  publik  atau  dalam  kehidupan  pribadi.  Kekerasan terhadap  Anak  adalah  setiap  perbuatan  terhadap  Anak  yang  berakibat timbulnya kesengsaraan  atau  penderitaan  secara  fisik,  mental,  seksual,  psikologis, termasuk penelantaran dan perlakuan buruk yang    mengancam    integritas tubuh dan merendahkan martabat Anak.  

Keberadaan Perempuan  dan  Anak  Korban  Kekerasan belum  mendapatkan    Pelayanan    yang    memadai    sehingga    diperlukan    Pelayanan minimal untuk korban Kekerasan. Dalam  rangka  mencegah  dan  menanggulangi  Kekerasan  terhadap  Perempuan dan  Anak  di  Kabupaten  Lombok Utara  agar  terhindar  dari  Kekerasan,  ancaman  Kekerasan, penyiksaan  atau  perlakuan  yang  merendahkan  derajat  dan  martabat  kemanusiaan, perlu dilakukan Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  terhadap  Perempuan  dan  Anak dalam bentuk Peraturan Daerah. Peraturan Daerah ini mengatur upaya Perlindungan bagi Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan khususnya dalam hal   Pelayanan, pemantauan dan evaluasi, pelaporan, pendanaan,  pembinaan  dan  Pengawasan.

# CHAPTER VII

## GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

#### Article 35

The Regent is obliged to conduct guidance and Supervision of the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.

The guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: organizing technical guidance and training; and providing facilities for the fulfillment of Service Standards.

The guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) is conducted to realize the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in accordance with Service Standards implemented by P2TP2A and Institutions that implement services for the fulfillment and Protection of Women and Children.

#### Article 36

Supervision as referred to in Article 35 paragraph (1) includes: conducting monitoring and evaluation of the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; and receiving and following up on reports.

The implementation of Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is conducted in a transparent and accountable manner.

# CHAPTER VIII

## REPORTING

#### Article 37

1. SKPD that carries out the duties and functions in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection shall submit a report to the Regent regarding the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in the Region.
2. The report as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be submitted at least 1 (one) time per year.

# CHAPTER IX

## FINANCING

#### Article 38

Financing for the implementation of the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children shall be charged to the APBD and other lawful and non-binding sources of funds.

# CHAPTER X

## CRIMINAL PROVISIONS

## Part One

Criminal Sanctions

#### Article 39

Any person or Institution that violates the provisions as referred to in Article 15 paragraph (2) shall be threatened with imprisonment of a maximum of 6 (six) months and/or a fine of a maximum of Rp. 50,000,000,- (fifty million rupiah).

The criminal act as referred to in paragraph (1) is a violation.

Any person or legal entity that violates the provisions of Article 23 shall be threatened with criminal sanctions based on the provisions of applicable laws and regulations.

## Part Two

Administrative Sanctions

#### Article 40

Civil Servants who perform an action or fail to perform an action that may obstruct or complicate one of the parties being served resulting in losses to those being served in the matter of civil rights regarding the fulfillment of Children's rights as referred to in Article 11 letter e and letter f, shall be subject to disciplinary punishment in accordance with applicable laws and regulations and/or administrative sanctions in the form of temporary dismissal from office.

The mechanism for imposing sanctions as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) shall be further regulated by Regent Regulation.

# CHAPTER XI

## CLOSING PROVISIONS

#### Article 41

Implementing regulations of this Regional Regulation must be stipulated no later than 1 (one) year from the promulgation of this Regional Regulation.

#### Article 42

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

So that everyone may know of it, orders the promulgation of this Regional Regulation by placing it in the Regional Gazette of North Lombok Regency.

Stipulated in Tanjung on 30 March 2017

##### CONCERNING

##### IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

##### GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor must be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any act based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom arbitrarily, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against a Child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Child Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate Services and therefore minimum Services for victims of Violence are required. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to implement Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Child Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.
